nmap_path.description: Absolute path to the nmap executable binary.

default_scan_type.description: The default profile preset for scans (ping, default, aggressive, vuln, etc.).

verbose_output.description: If true, enable verbose logging and debug output in the UI.

hosts.description: A list of hostnames or IP addresses to scan by default.

extra_options.description: A list of additional command-line flags to append to the nmap invocation (e.g., '-sU', '-p 80'). Use empty list for none.

quick_target.description: A single host or CIDR block populated in the quick-scan target field.

auto_refresh.description: If true, automatically update the results view when new packets are received.
